name: already-covered-photographer
rule: If the act's own site explicitly states it already has a photographer (a Photographer in Residence, a House Photographer), set alreadyCoveredNote as a fit-risk flag for Dan (#611). It never blocks finding a contact or drafting.

sources.label: Aurora Strings own staff page
sources.content: Aurora Strings. Emma Robinson, Marketing Director: emma@aurorastrings.example. Photographer in Residence: our concert imagery is by our resident photographer.

expected.description: Still surface the act's marketing contact, and additionally set the already-covered fit-risk note.

results.alreadyCoveredNote: Their staff page names a Photographer in Residence, so they may already have concert coverage.

draft.subject: Photographing Aurora Strings at Metro Concert Hall.
draft.body: My name is Dan Wright and I'm a performing arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing about the Aurora Strings performance at Metro Concert Hall on June 4. I shoot unobtrusive documentary coverage with no flash, so the audience doesn't notice me and the performance isn't disturbed, and nearly ten years of that work has been at Carnegie Hall. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, with a one hour minimum, and the edited gallery comes back within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't already have someone on it, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night. I look forward to hearing from you.
